issuing_authority: Local Self Government Department, Government of Kerala

sections.heading: Mandatory Clearances in Ecologically Sensitive Zones
sections.content: Section 12(3): No building permit shall be issued for commercial projects exceeding 3,000 sq.m. in ecologically sensitive zones without prior environmental clearance from SEIAA (State Environment Impact Assessment Authority).

sections.heading: Setback Requirements Near Water Bodies
sections.content: Section 15(1): Minimum setback of 10m from water body edge required for all commercial constructions.

sections.heading: Local-Body No Objection Certificate
sections.content: Section 18(2): Local-body NOC mandatory before permit issuance for any commercial construction exceeding 1,000 sq.m.

sections.heading: Penalties for Unlawful Construction
sections.content: Section 24: Penalty for construction without mandatory permits or clearances: immediate demolition order + fine up to ₹10 lakh.
